svg.title: The park at the bottom of the hill, Saturday, four o'clock
svg.desc: A city park on a Saturday afternoon with a football game, a bench with two people and a guitar, three runners, somebody drawing, and a concert poster on a wall.

g.text: The park at the bottom of the hill, Saturday, four o'clock
Fourteen things to find. Eleven people are doing something and four are watching them.
the wall - and the concert poster on it
the pitch - a game every Saturday for nine years
the cafe at the gate - closed at four
the clock on the gate: four o'clock
eleven playing, and nobody organised it
Emre - a guitar that belongs to nobody
Lin - on the bench, and she came to play
a bag, a bottle, and a dog asleep on both
